title: Express the sharp inequality as a least-norm compatible cubic lift
statement: Differentiate D2J(A)[E,E]=|S(A,E)|^2+2lambda(A)det E in A along G with E=G. Quartic polarization gives pointwise3DJ(G):A=S(A,G).S(G,G)+Dlambda(A)[G]det G. For actual compatible mean-zero G, K_G^*K_G=H and3b=K_G^*g_G+r_G,with r_G=int Dlambda(G)det G. Accepted b inrangeH implies r_G inrangeH. The least-norm solution K_G^*z=3b is z_min=P_G g_G+K_G H^dagger r_G, P_G=K_G H^dagger K_G^*, an orthogonal projection onto the finite-dimensional strain range, not compatible-gradient projection. The remaining sharp inequality is EXACTLY ||z_min||2^2<=18c. Let q_G=int lambda(G)det G; Euler gives ||g_G||2^2=12c-2q_G and exact defect18c-||z_min||2^2=6c+2q_G+||(I-P_G)g_G||2^2-2(K_G^*g_G)^T H^dagger r_G-r_G^T H^dagger r_G. Every term is finite forL4 G, but no sign/control of the correction is proved. At A=I,D=diag(2,-m),S(I,D)=0 while Dlambda(I)[D]=3n ell/m,detD=-2m,DJ(D):I=-2n ell!=0; thus no finite pointwise |DJ(G):A|<=C sqrt(J(G))|S(A,G)| bound. D is constant, not an admissible mean-zero periodic negative. Compatibility/integration remain essential.
